messages:
Priya Nair: FYI 1: Q2 budget guardrails are live. Key points: sponsorships capped at $20k without exec signoff, any multi-year vendor contract requires procurement + legal before commit, and all unbudgeted spend >$3k needs a budget exception ticket. See: https://redwood.example.com/finance/q2-guardrails

Tom Rivera: Thanks Priya. For conferences, is the $20k cap per event or per vendor?

Priya Nair: Per event. If you're doing a booth + sponsorship package that exceeds $20k, you'll need a director-level approval and procurement intake. Short timeline exceptions (less than 10 business days) should be flagged as "expedite" in the intake form.

Janelle Wu: Quick ask: our sponsorship lead time is short for May. What's the fastest way to get approvals through?

Priya Nair: Two options: (1) submit an expedited procurement intake, mark as "sponsorship-expedite", and tag @Tom Rivera for director approval; (2) if it's a known vendor with an existing contract, request a PO amendment via the Supplier Portal and select "fast-track". Both will route to procurement and legal concurrently.

BudgetsBot: Automated reminder: all teams must confirm Q2 headcount and FTE budget by Friday EOD. Missing confirmations will lock hiring approvals.

SaaS Ops: For recurring SaaS auto-renewals 1: we need to start the cleanup. Can procurement share the current list of renewal dates?

Priya Nair: Yes 1: procurement will export the renewal roster and share a CSV by Wednesday. Please tag vendors you want consolidated. Also, add estimated annual spend in the `renewal_notes` column so we can prioritize.

Tom Rivera: One more on vendor approvals: if a vendor has passed security review but legal review is pending, can procurement issue a provisional PO to lock pricing?

Priya Nair: We can issue a provisional PO only for existing approved vendors and when the contract value is <$10k. Anything above requires signed contract. Provisional POs must include `provisional=true` in the portal and will expire after 30 days.

Janelle Wu: Noted. I'll submit the expedite for the May event and include the sponsor deck and expected ROI metrics. Any recommended coding for the GL?

Priya Nair: Use `MKT-EVT` for events (GL 4621) and `MKT-SPONS` for sponsorship line items (GL 4622). Add `campaign` tag to the PO.

BudgetsBot: Policy update acknowledgement requested: please react with :white_check_mark: once you've reviewed Q2 guardrails.

Tom Rivera: Reacted. :white_check_mark:

Janelle Wu: Reacted. :white_check_mark:

Priya Nair: Thanks team. If you hit any edge cases ping #procurement-help and include the procurement intake ID. I'll follow up with the renewal CSV on Wednesday.
